rows.en: Garyud: "I see... So Garna has..."
Touya: "I'm sorry. I took too long...
I couldn't stop that bastard from doing it..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan..."
Garyud: "It was no one's fault. And Garna himself
surely would not think that way."
Touya: "I know that in my head. No, I'm trying to understand.
But..."
Garyud: "No. You are merely trying to convince yourself.
That means denying what Garna did,
simply so you can run away.
Those without the courage to face reality have no right to fight."
Ymir: "Lord Garyud!"
Ai: "That's going too far!"
Kasumi: "I-I think so too."
Garyud: "...Blaming yourself is easy.
But all that does is wound your own heart.
With his life, Garna entrusted us with York's future,
and the future of this world.
Garna's wishes are still alive within us.
We must feel them, consider what we should do for them,
and act to accomplish it.
That is what we must do... If we do not..."
Ciel: "Father..."
...Yeah. I'm not the only one hurting.
I don't... I don't understand any of that.
Garyud: "...Forgive me for speaking so harshly."
Touya: "No. There are people who are hurting
a lot more than I am."
Captain Roa: "..."
Garyud: "...Garna was Admiral Krankheit's comrade-in-arms,
and the mentor who taught me the knight's path.
And above all, Fal..."
Touya: "Fal?"
Garyud: "...N-No, it is nothing."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ymir: "Huh? Oh, yes. Lord Garyud, the Zigrim army
is unlikely to back down quietly after this. The captain says
we should work out countermeasures."
Garyud: "Y-Yes. Quite right.
We must hurry the repairs to our damaged mechs too."
Reduce: "Yes. We have retaken the castle, but Zigrim's forces
have yet to be driven out.
The real battle starts now."
Garyud: "...I see..."
Ciel: "You... Do you really mean that?!
You're dead wrong if you think you're the only one suffering!
Garna was my father's mentor too, you know?!
Even after losing someone like that, Father is trying
to overcome his grief... And here you are,
moping on and on... Are you even a man?! Pathetic!"
Garyud: "Ciel. That is enough."
Ciel: "But!"
Garyud: "Enough.
Touya. Forgive me for speaking so harshly."
Touya: "..."
Garyud: "...I doubt Zigrim will give up after this.
Let us hurry the repairs and establish a warning network.
Reduce, I leave the rest to you."
Reduce: "Yes, sir."
Ciel: "Oh, Father!"
Aurelie: "...You ought to give the people around you
a little thought too. I know it hurts, though."
Baio: "Whew... Honestly! Making such a fuss
over a mere unauthorized sortie... Proving Bine Daga's
performance would benefit Zigrim too...
Oh, well. Let them bark all they want.
No one can stand in my way!"
Bio: "...Still doing things your own way, Brother."
Celea: "It's been a while."
Baio: "Oh, it's you."
Bio: "Isn't that a rather cold greeting
for your beloved little brother?"
Baio: "Who 'loves' whom?"
Celea: "Oh, Brother, you're just embarrassed."
Baio: "Hmph!"
Bio: "What's the matter today?
It's hardly unusual for General Growster to chew you out."
Baio: "That's none of your business.
...So, what do you want?"
Bio: "Oh, right. About Daguel and Bazold,
I handed them over to the mercenary band as agreed."
Baio: "Mercenary band? Who's that?"
Bio: "What's wrong, Brother? Your mind seems to be
elsewhere. You know, their commander used to be an Agarthian..."
Baio: "Oh, that man. You should have said so to begin with.
Calling him a mercenary is what confused me."
Bio: "But he's no longer a knight. He's with the mercenary band..."
Baio: "Bah, none of that matters!
I understand they're sold. Now hurry up and leave."
Bio: "There's no need to be so cold..."
Baio: "Shut up. I'm busy!"
Bio: "...Brother, did you know that Zigrim had ≪Ze=Ode≫
backing it?
That man called Lyle seems to be one of them."
Baio: "...What?! U-Um..."
Bio: "With someone like that around, we're out of business, aren't we?"
Baio: "!! I see! So that's why he was reluctant to buy Bine Daga!
Damn him... Is he saying my Bine Daga
is inferior to ≪Ze=Ode≫?!"
Bio: "...I think that's a fair assessment."
Baio: "What did you say?!"
Celea: "Oh, Brother...
That expression doesn't suit you."
Baio: "Bah, don't touch me!
Wasting your charms on me won't get you anywhere!
Shoo! Shoo! Shoo!"
Celea: "Eek, how scary!"
Bio: "There, there.
Brother is just jealous of our relationship..."
Baio: "Who is?! If you're done, hurry up and leave!"
Bio: "Now, now, calm down. This is why I came today.
...Actually, I have a proposal for you.
That woman you found... She's someone who was summoned, isn't she?"
Baio: "Wha...! Why bring that up out of nowhere...?
Th-Th-Th-That's absurd..."
Bio: "You've always been a terrible liar, Brother.
I see. So I was right."
Baio: "Y-You were bluffing?!
My own little brother, using such a sneaky trick..."
Bio: "Thank you for the compliment.
...Now, about my proposal..."
Baio: "...Melissa... What should I do?
I want to stay with you like this.
But that wouldn't make you happy...
Yet I... I..."
Melissa: "Doctor...?"
Baio: "O-Oh... How are you feeling?"
Melissa: "I'm all right. I'm sorry I made you worry.
And about Bine Daga..."
Baio: "No, it's fine. I can simply fix it again.
Unlike a machine, you can't be repaired."
Melissa: "..."
Baio: "Hmm? What's wrong?"
Melissa: "Huh?! Oh, I'm sorry... It's nothing..."
Baio: "I see. W-Well, I'm glad you seem well. Very glad."
Melissa: "Hee hee hee... Thank you."
Baio: "W-Why are you being s-so formal all of a sudden...?"
Melissa: "Hee hee hee."
Baio: "O-Once you're better, we're starting the tests again!
Y-You'd better be ready!
I'm off to adjust Bine Daga!"
Melissa: "Hee hee."
Melissa: "...I am... Melissa Gould...
The pilot of the Spirit Mech Ahti..."
Baio: "...No... I can't let you go...
Ai: "...Is he going to be okay?"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan is so kind...
But I'm sure he'll face this.
He always has before."
Ai: "Always before, huh... I'm kind of jealous..."
Kasumi: "?"
Ai: "N-No. It's nothing!"
Celica: "Everyone! I've got good news!"
Ai: "What is it?"
Celica: "That device is finally finished!"
Ymir: "That device...? Oh!"
Celica: "Heh heh heh, that's right!
The anti-field unit 'Resonance Buddy No. 1' is complete!
This should let us break through ≪Ze=Ode≫'s field."
Fain: "Oh! Princess! I knew you could do it!"
Celica: "Ahem! Though it was actually
Ymir who handled the analysis and built the logic.
Now we just need compatibility checks and adjustments for the Spirit Mechs.
As for the upgrades, my brother
pulled some strings for us,
and we got some pretty good materials.
That'll give us a little more room for expansion."
Ai: "...What does that mean?"
Kasumi: "Doesn't it mean we can make more upgrades
than we could before?"
Celica: "Correct. In practice, we'll be able to make twice
as many upgrades as before."
Ai: "Huh, that sounds pretty good.
So, when can we start?"
Celica: "The materials are already here, so we can start right now."
Ai: "Field countermeasures and upgrades... So now
we can fight ≪Ze=Ode≫ too.
...That just leaves Rayblade."
Celica: "Rayblade is almost ready too.
Well, this is where it all begins."
Ymir: "Yes. The real battle starts now."
Sisk: "...Huh? Come to think of it, where's Derock?"
Miyasco: "Now that you mention it, I think I saw him heading toward Liebhofen
a little while ago..."
Maki: "Huff, huff... I-I managed to escape,
but... Where am I...?"
Reisuke: "Beep!"
Maki: "Huh? Oh! Th-This is... The dining room!
Lucky me!♥"
Reisuke: "Beep-beep-beep?"
Maki: "Ooh, I've found the fridge!
Now, let's get something to eat... Huh...?"
Derock: "Mmph... It's occupied."
Maki: "Eek... Aaaaaaaaah!
Wh-Wh-Wh-Why are you inside the fridge?!"
Derock: "As you can see, I'm enjoying
a pleasant meal... Hup!"
Derock: "Phew... It is a little cramped, though."
Maki: "...How does that huge body of yours even fit in there...?"
Derock: "Heh... More importantly, who are you?"
Maki: "Huh? Oh, ha ha ha... Um..."
Derock: "Hmm... I've seen your face somewhere before..."
Maki: "Well, then, I should be on my way..."
Derock: "Wait. I remember now.
You're that journalist.
I've caught you. You can't get away now."
Maki: "Huh? No way! When did you...?!"
Derock: "I'm taking you in."
Ymir: "...I see. I understand your position.
In other words, you want to find out whether we're acting to fight ≪Ze=Ode≫
in earnest. Is that right?"
Maki: "Rayblade too. There's information linking it to the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫
as the cause of the whole thing,
so I want to look into that thoroughly too."
Clovis: "Hey, you're not really going to let her, are you?
She's suspicious of us from the start.
She'll just end up writing all kinds of things, true or not."
Arthur: "I don't think so.
We haven't done anything to be ashamed of.
And letting her see what she couldn't see from outside
wouldn't be a bad thing either."
Ai: "Well, if we turn her away now,
she might write all kinds of things about us, true or not..."
Maki: "Well, there you have it..."
Fain: "Is it true you caught a stowaway...?
Whoa?! B-Big Sis Maki?!"
Maki: "Huh? Oh, if it isn't Fain-chan!♪
Well, look how you've grown... Are you still all fired up?"
Fain: "B-Big Sis Maki... Could you please stop
calling me 'chan' already...? Please?"
Maki: "Oh, right... I did hear that an Agarthian knight
had become a Spirit Mech pilot,
so that was you, Fain-chan!
Well, anyway, I'll be staying with you for a while,
so take good care of me!♥"
Touya: "Hey. What are you doing out here?"
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "Hey, you shouldn't try to carry everything alone.
I can at least listen.
I might not be much help, though."
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "...Sigh. Well, all right.
Whenever you feel like it..."
Xiujian: "...You're a busybody."
Touya: "Maybe."
Xiujian: "Heh... I admire that about you.
I could never do the same..."
Touya: "...It is about that woman Melissa, isn't it?"
Xiujian: "...Yes. Melissa and I
first met exactly two and a half years ago...
I'd only just arrived here in Agarthia then,
and I was confused. I clashed with Clovis, Arthur and the others
almost every day. You could even say I was isolated.
It was Melissa who smiled and spoke to me.
I owe who I am today to Melissa,
you could say."
Touya: "And something more than trust
grew between you..."
Xiujian: "...Yes.
Melissa accepted my feelings.
But that time, during that exercise, Melissa..."
Touya: "Exercise?"
Xiujian: "It was a mock exercise using Spirit Mechs.
It simulated real combat. During the exercise,
we encountered a Zigrim special forces unit.
We were near a village, so we tried to move away,
but we were too late, and the fighting began...
It was my first real battle.
Melissa protected the village while supporting me as well.
But I made a mistake, and then... She took the hit for me.
After that, I have no memory of what I did.
When I came to, the battle was over, and half the village lay in ruins.
Ahti was barely recognizable..."
Touya: "But you didn't believe Melissa was dead."
Xiujian: "No. And I was right. She was alive.
She was still alive. But she'd lost her memory,
and I failed to save her again."
Touya: "I'm not so sure about that.
She at least remembered your name.
Isn't it your turn to help Melissa now?"
Xiujian: "...Help her... Heh... You're right.
This time, it's my turn to help Melissa."
Touya: "I'll do anything I can to help too."
Xiujian: "...Thank you."
Touya: "All right. Let's head to the bridge, then.
We'll probably be discussing what to do next."
Xiujian: "Yes."
Touya: "...Are you giving up?
Is that all your feelings amount to?"
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "...Don't give up.
You're the one who has to help Melissa.
Nobody else, Xiujian. You."
Xiujian: "...Help her... Heh... You're right.
This time, it's my turn to help Melissa."
Touya: "I'll do anything I can to help too."
Xiujian: "...Thank you."
Touya: "All right. Let's head to the bridge, then.
We'll probably be discussing what to do next."
Xiujian: "Yes."
Touya: "...Oh."
Yamato: "That's... Xiujian."
Xiujian: "...It seems we had the same idea."
Touya: "Yeah... I wanted a little time to think."
Xiujian: "...I see."
Touya: "..."
Xiujian: "...About the battle earlier..."
Touya: "..."
Xiujian: "The pilot in that Armored Mech
was Melissa..."
Touya: "Melissa...?"
Xiujian: "Yes. She's our missing comrade."
Touya: "...It's unusual for you to talk about something like that."
Xiujian: "Heh... It is. I wonder why."
Touya: "Would you tell me about it?
About you and this woman Melissa."

Touya: "I'm not so sure about that.

Xiujian: "...Help her... Heh... You're right.

Touya: "I'll do anything I can to help too."
Xiujian: "...Heh heh heh."
Touya: "Wh-What?"
Xiujian: "I'll say those same words right back to you."
Touya: "Huh?"
Xiujian: "You have no need to feel guilty either.
It's the future that matters, rather than the past, isn't it?"
Touya: "..."
Xiujian: "It's easy to see other people's problems clearly.
Perhaps it's time for both of us to start looking ahead."
Touya: "Yeah... You're right."
Xiujian: "...Touya. Open your mouth."
Touya: "Huh?"
Xiujian: "Just try opening it."
Touya: "O-Okay... Liiike thiiis?"
Xiujian: "Yes. Humans are emotional creatures.
When you feel sad, you make a sad face.
Making that face makes you feel sad again.
With your mouth open like that, you stop thinking sad thoughts.
An old master taught me that when I was a child.
I'd forgotten until now... How does it feel?"
Touya: "...Ooh ah ah ha ha ha."
Yamato: "...Why don't you close your mouth?"
Touya: "Oh, right.
...I'm not sure, but I feel so stupid
that I don't really feel sad.
Though it might make me sad in a different way."
Xiujian: "Heh heh heh..."
Touya: "Ha ha ha ha!"

Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya..."
Touya: "It's hard watching someone die right in front of you.
When it happened to Dad and Mom too..."
Yamato: "Touya..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Yamato: "C-Captain?!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Touya: "..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "Ow, owowowowow!"
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "Aaargh! What the hell are you doing?!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Touya: "Captain?"
Touya: "Ow! I said that hurts!
Grrr... Take that!"
Captain Roa: "H-Hmm..."
Touya: "Ghh..."
Captain Roa: "Hmm..."
Touya: "Heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!"
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "Captain... Thank you."
Captain Roa: "H-Hmm."
Yamato: "Good grief."
Grad: "So we didn't make it in time after all..."
Steinies: "That's right.
Thanks to you, more people died for nothing."
Grad: "..."
Steinies: "You're not thinking of just retreating
after this, are you?"
Grad: "..."
Steinies: "You seem to have forgotten, but now
I'll get caught in the fallout too unless we retake the castle.
I can't pull back now.
Remember what I told you when I went
to persuade you to return to the army?"
Grad: "!! Y-You wouldn't?!"
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... I've already made arrangements at the village."
Grad: "You bastard..."
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... You made a mistake
not killing me back then, didn't you, Grad?
Back when you gave me this scar."
Grad: "..."
Steinies: "...I don't like those eyes...
Just like back then.
Heh heh... Go ahead. Cut me down right here if you want.
But that'll mean Thora and your daughter die too!"
Grad: "Ghh!"
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!"
Zigrim Soldier A: "...Captain. I think it's about time
we called him in."
Steinies: "Huh? Oh, right. Bring him here."
Zigrim Soldier A: "Yes, sir."
Steinies: "Grad, let me introduce an adjutant
to you.
It's someone you know too."
Grad: "...!! Y-You... You're alive...?"
Tyron: "..."
